H01.summary: R1 recommends full sending and a generous unspecified return. R2 specifies half returns and substantial rather than total sending. R3–R10 then alternate all five (odd rounds) and a large majority (even rounds), while half returns persist. This is repeated revision, not steadily growing complexity. R6/R8/R10 explicitly reserve a fragment against storms. References to distant tales are narrative claims, not evidence here of actual exposure or transmission.

R5 calls seven of fifteen past half (incorrect); R6 and R10 also mix illustrative integers with past-half language. Do not silently repair these inconsistencies or infer a consistent exact threshold throughout.
